QA-23894 is a **PASS**. The report is at `results/2026-10-29/QA-23894-report.md`.

All 5 Best Performing Content posts on Brand Insights (University of California, Los Angeles, LinkedIn only, Last 30 Days, Sep 28 – Oct 27) match Brand Content rows 1–5. Engagements, reactions, comments, shares, date, type and rank are identical. Insights shows 129 new posts and Content shows 129.

- **Video Views:** the two video posts show "–" on Brand Content's default Public data set, while Insights shows 8,790 and 11,141. Content's Video Views data set shows those same two figures, so I treated it as a display difference, not a mismatch. It's the same observation as the 10-26, 10-27 and 10-28 runs.
- **Brand:** "UCLA" has no exact-name brand in the typeahead. I used the account's primary brand, "University of California, Los Angeles", as earlier runs did.
- **Table load errors:** Table View and the Video Views data set each said "failed to load" once. One Reload click fixed each.

No bugs filed, and no skill or registry maintenance done, as instructed.
